candidate_plan.title: Bounded Metadata Emission with File Fallback
candidate_plan.script_implementation:
def emit_metadata(data, output_dir):
    raw = json.dumps(data, indent=2).encode('utf-8')
    if len(raw) <= 1500:
        sys.stdout.buffer.write(raw)
        return
    # Overflow: save full data to owned artifact and emit measured pointer <= 1500 bytes
    target = Path(output_dir) / 'metadata-full.json'
    target.write_bytes(raw)
    summary = json.dumps({
        'status': 'OUTPUT_WRITTEN_TO_FILE',
        'path': str(target),
        'bytes': len(raw),
        'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    }).encode('utf-8')
    assert len(summary) <= 1500
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(summary)
candidate_plan.proposed_execution: Execute emit_metadata() to emit pre-measured metadata for any arbitrary payload size up to 100 MiB.
